title: Numerical invariants — Question 13.4
source_location: Question13.4 and its remark, printed p30; Section13.2 begins p29
target_paraphrase: Find taut foliations F and G on one hyperbolic 3-manifold whose lifted G isotopy orbit accumulates on lifted F in a finite cover, although the downstairs G isotopy orbit does not accumulate on F. Alternatively rule out all such examples.
geometric_topology: Geometric convergence as plane fields, as in the cited Gromov-norm paper Theorem3.1.2; no C2 or Godbillon–Vey continuity is imposed.
scope_warning: The short question does not explicitly say closed, oriented or cooriented. Any result proved only for a closed/oriented/cooriented subclass will be labeled as such.
upstream_prior_report: Source-only OPEN-TRIAGE, no example or proof; credited context, not prior campaign attempt.
